# Out-of-repo reference fixture

Exactly one defect, on both of the gate's resolution paths: the link and the section
reference below both point above the scanned tree. The test creates a real
`outside-doc.md` there, so a gate with no containment check resolves both and exits 0 —
declaring the repo good on the strength of a file the repo does not own.

See [outside](../../outside-doc.md) and ../../outside-doc.md §2 for details.
